result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there are a few visual/layout polish issues: horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge, some text is truncated, and the top-right avatar/notification indicator looks ambiguous. No critical blockers are visible.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge, causing the third restaurant card and name ('Trattoria Piccol...') to be partially clipped/truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right-side peek padding or edge inset so partially visible cards look intentionally scrollable rather than cropped; ensure restaurant names truncate cleanly with ellipsis within fully visible cards.

issues.description: The category filter row is also clipped at the right edge after 'Healthy', making the next chip only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Use symmetrical horizontal padding and a fade/scroll indicator so off-screen chips are clearly part of a scrollable row.

issues.description: The top-right profile/avatar area is a plain gray circle with a small red dot, which reads like a broken image or unclear notification badge.
issues.suggestion: Use a clear profile icon/avatar and align the notification badge to a standard position with sufficient contrast.

issues.description: Promo text '3 free deliveries for you' and code details are readable, but the minimum-order condition is easy to miss because it is on the same line as the code.
issues.suggestion: Separate the code and eligibility condition visually, e.g. bold the code and place 'min. order €10' on its own line or smaller caption.
